en.headline: Taxi driver arrested after man struck in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A man was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital with facial injuries after a taxi hit him near Sham Shui Po Park early on Friday.
body: Police arrested a taxi driver early on Friday after a taxi struck a man on Tung Chau Street in Sham Shui Po. The man was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital with injuries to his face.

The collision happened at about midnight as the taxi travelled toward Mong Kok and reached a pedestrian crossing opposite Sham Shui Po Park, according to reports. Rescuers found the man still breathing and with a pulse. Accounts differed on whether he was briefly unconscious.
Police held the driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. He was detained for inquiries. The taxi was later towed away, and traffic at the scene returned to normal.
Officers said they were still looking into how the collision happened, including where the man was at the time and how the taxi was being driven. No further details of his condition were released.

zh.headline: 深水埗的士撞倒過路男子 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周五凌晨通州街近深水埗公園有的士撞倒一名男子，傷者面部受傷送瑪嘉烈醫院，司機涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。
body: 周五凌晨，深水埗通州街發生交通意外，一輛的士撞倒一名男子。傷者面部受傷，由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院。警方其後拘捕涉事的士司機。
據報道，意外約於午夜發生。的士沿通州街往旺角方向行駛，駛至深水埗公園對開一個行人過路處時撞到該名男子。救援人員到場時，傷者仍有呼吸及脈搏。各報道對他當時是否一度昏迷的說法並不一致。
警方以涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害拘捕司機，並把他扣留調查。涉事的士其後被拖走，現場交通回復正常。
警方表示仍在調查意外成因，包括傷者當時的位置及的士的行車情況。院方未有公布傷者的進一步情況。
